title: Unique Performance Arts Center news
description: Unique Performance Arts Center (UPAC) — dance and musical theater classes for ages 18 months through adult in West Orange, NJ. Ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop, creative movement and the award-winning UPAC Troupe. Established 1998.

items.title: Wear It Pink Week
items.summary: Pink from leotards to socks for Breast Cancer Awareness Month.
items.content_html:
Pink leotards, pink sweatshirts, pink socks: Wear It Pink Week at the studio for Breast Cancer Awareness Month.

It is part of October at UPAC, alongside the pink-ribbon wall and the fundraiser for AAngelsNJ.
